gene_expression_viewer.sample_label: Both samples (NP21-104, N21-202), each spot plotted at its true tissue position, side by side
gene_expression_viewer.embedding_method: scanpy 1.10.3: read_10x_mtx of each sample's deposited 10x Visium output (barcodes/features/matrix), joined against its own tissue_positions_list.csv, kept in_tissue==1 spots only (3740 and 2959 spots), QC (min 100 genes/spot), anndata.concat with each sample's array_col offset so both tissue sections render side by side rather than overlapping. Plotted coordinates are the TRUE physical Visium hex-grid position (array_row/array_col), not a UMAP -- spatial layout is the point of this modality, so an abstract embedding would discard the one thing that makes it different from regular scRNA-seq. Clustering (Leiden, resolution 0.5, 8 clusters) still uses transcriptional similarity via PCA/neighbors, same as scRNA-seq.
gene_expression_viewer.integration_note: Spots are plotted at true tissue position per sample, not merged into one shared coordinate space -- the two samples are independent tissue sections side by side, not directly overlaid.
